$comment: Everyone on the trip. `id` is referenced by expenses and stays, so change
names freely but do not renumber ids once expenses exist.
`shares` weights the default equal split — leave at 1 for a normal split,
or use 2 for a couple sharing one entry.
`color` identifies a person in the balance bars and split chips; the six
here are drawn from the palette in assets/css/base.css so they stay
distinguishable from each other and legible in dark mode.
